title: Hold a deer farm licence
what: Operate a deer farm (land where deer are kept for any purpose) only under a deer farm licence from the Secretary.

sources.title: Nature Conservation (Deer Farming) Regulations 2022 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not operate a deer farm unless the person – (a) holds a deer farm licence to operate the deer farm

sources.title: Nature Conservation (Deer Farming) Regulations 2022 (Tas)
sources.quote: deer farm means an area of land where deer are kept for any purpose including, but not limited to, for farming, as a hobby, and as pets

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Nature Conservation Act 2002 (Tas)
